title: Commit Records inside Loop
description: Performance rule — Commit Records/Requests inside a Loop writes to the database on every iteration.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Committing per iteration multiplies record locks and server round-trips.
rule.remediation: Commit once after the loop where the data model allows it.
